    21→
    22→export async function handleDangerous(
    23→  interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction,
    24→  adapter: DiscordAdapter,
    25→): Promise<void> {
    26→  await interaction.deferReply({ ephemeral: true })
    27→
    28→  const channelId = interaction.channelId
    29→  const session = adapter.core.sessionManager.getSessionByThread('discord', channelId)
    30→
    31→  if (session) {
    32→    session.dangerousMode = !session.dangerousMode
    33→    adapter.core.sessionManager.patchRecord(session.id, { dangerousMode: session.dangerousMode }).catch(() => {})
    34→    log.info({ sessionId: session.id, dangerousMode: session.dangerousMode }, '[discord-admin] Dangerous mode toggled via command')
    35→
    36→    const msg = session.dangerousMode
    37→      ? '☠️ **Dangerous mode enabled** — All permission requests will be auto-approved.'
    38→      : '🔐 **Dangerous mode disabled** — Permission requests will be shown normally.'
    39→    await interaction.editReply(msg)
    40→    return
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  // Session not in memory — update store directly
    44→  const record = adapter.core.sessionManager.getRecordByThread('discord', channelId)
    45→  if (!record || record.status === 'cancelled' || record.status === 'error') {
    46→    await interaction.editReply('⚠️ No active session in this channel.')
    47→    return
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  const newDangerousMode = !(record.dangerousMode ?? false)
    51→  adapter.core.sessionManager.patchRecord(record.sessionId, { dangerousMode: newDangerousMode }).catch(() => {})
    52→  log.info({ sessionId: record.sessionId, dangerousMode: newDangerousMode }, '[discord-admin] Dangerous mode toggled via command (store-only)')
    53→
    54→  const msg = newDangerousMode
    55→    ? '☠️ **Dangerous mode enabled** — All permission requests will be auto-approved.'
    56→    : '🔐 **Dangerous mode disabled** — Permission requests will be shown normally.'
    57→  await interaction.editReply(msg)
    58→}

    60→export async function handleDangerousButton(
    61→  interaction: ButtonInteraction,
    62→  adapter: DiscordAdapter,
    63→): Promise<void> {
    64→  const sessionId = interaction.customId.slice(2) // strip 'd:'
    65→  const session = adapter.core.sessionManager.getSession(sessionId)
    66→
    67→  // Session live in memory — toggle directly

    .setName('doctor')
    .setDescription('Run system diagnostics'),

    .setName('handoff')
    .setDescription('Generate a terminal resume command for this session'),

  new SlashCommandBuilder()
    .setName('clear')

]

}

     6→import type { ChatInputCommandInteraction, ButtonInteraction } from 'discord.js'

    12→export async function handleNew(
    13→  interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction,
    14→  adapter: DiscordAdapter,
    15→): Promise<void> {
    16→  await interaction.deferReply({ ephemeral: true })
    17→
    18→  const agentName = interaction.options.getString('agent') ?? undefined
    19→  const workspace = interaction.options.getString('workspace') ?? undefined
    20→
    21→  if (agentName) {
    22→    await executeNewSession(interaction, adapter, agentName, workspace)
    23→    return
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  // No agent specified — show agent picker
    27→  const installedEntries = adapter.core.agentCatalog.getInstalledEntries()
    28→  const agentKeys = Object.keys(installedEntries)
    29→  const config = adapter.core.configManager.get()
    30→
    31→  if (agentKeys.length === 0) {
    32→    await interaction.editReply('❌ No agents installed. Use `/install` to install an agent first.')
    33→    return
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  if (agentKeys.length === 1) {
    37→    await executeNewSession(interaction, adapter, config.defaultAgent, workspace)
    38→    return
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  // Multiple agents — show picker buttons
    42→  const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>()
    43→  for (const key of agentKeys) {
    44→    const agent = installedEntries[key]!
    45→    const label = key === config.defaultAgent ? `${agent.name} (default)` : agent.name
    46→    row.addComponents(
    47→      new ButtonBuilder()
    48→        .setCustomId(`m:new:agent:${key}`)
    49→        .setLabel(label)
    50→        .setStyle(ButtonStyle.Primary),
    51→    )
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  await interaction.editReply({
    55→    content: '🤖 **Choose an agent:**',
    56→    components: [row],
    57→  })
    58→}
    59→
    60→export async function handleNewChat(
    61→  interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction,
    62→  adapter: DiscordAdapter,
    63→): Promise<void> {
    64→  await interaction.deferReply({ ephemeral: true })
    65→
    66→  // Get current thread to inherit config from
    67→  const channelId = interaction.channelId
    68→  const currentSession = adapter.core.sessionManager.getSessionByThread('discord', channelId)
    69→
    70→  let agentName: string | undefined
    71→  let workspace: string | undefined
    72→
    73→  if (currentSession) {
    74→    agentName = currentSession.agentName
    75→    workspace = currentSession.workingDirectory
    76→  } else {
    77→    const record = adapter.core.sessionManager.getRecordByThread('discord', channelId)
    78→    if (!record || record.status === 'cancelled' || record.status === 'error') {
    79→      await interaction.editReply('No active session in this channel. Use `/new` to start one.')
    80→      return
    81→    }
    82→    agentName = record.agentName
    83→    workspace = record.workingDir
    84→  }
    85→
    86→  await executeNewSession(interaction, adapter, agentName, workspace)
    87→}
    88→
    89→export async function executeNewSession(
    90→  interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction | ButtonInteraction,
    91→  adapter: DiscordAdapter,
    92→  agentName?: string,
    93→  workspace?: string,
    94→): Promise<void> {
    95→  const config = adapter.core.configManager.get()
    96→  const resolvedAgent = agentName || config.defaultAgent
    97→
    98→  log.info({ agentName: resolvedAgent, workspace }, '[discord-new-session] Creating session')
    99→
   100→  const forumChannel = adapter.getForumChannel()
   101→  if (!forumChannel) {
   102→    const msg = '❌ Forum channel not configured. Please run setup first.'
   103→    if (interaction.deferred || interaction.replied) {
   104→      await interaction.editReply(msg)
   105→    } else {
   106→      await (interaction as ChatInputCommandInteraction).reply({ content: msg, ephemeral: true })
   107→    }
   108→    return
   109→  }
   110→
   111→  let thread: import('discord.js').ThreadChannel | undefined
   112→
   113→  try {
   114→    // Create forum thread BEFORE creating session to avoid race condition
   115→    thread = await createSessionThread(forumChannel, `🔄 ${resolvedAgent} — New Session`)
   116→
   117→    // Create session via core
   118→    const session = await adapter.core.handleNewSession('discord', resolvedAgent, workspace)
   119→    session.threadId = thread.id
   120→
   121→    // Patch platform record with Discord thread ID
   122→    await adapter.core.sessionManager.patchRecord(session.id, {
   123→      platform: { threadId: thread.id },
   124→    })
   125→
   126→    // Send welcome message in the new thread
   127→    const dangerousRow = buildDangerousModeKeyboard(session.id, false)
   128→    await thread.send({
   129→      content:
   130→        `✅ **Session started**\n` +
   131→        `**Agent:** ${session.agentName}\n` +
   132→        `**Workspace:** \`${session.workingDirectory}\`\n\n` +
   133→        `This is your coding session — chat here to work with the agent.`,
   134→      components: [dangerousRow],
   135→    })
   136→
   137→    // Reply to the interaction with a link to the thread
   138→    const replyMsg = `✅ Session created → [Open thread](https://discord.com/channels/${adapter.getGuildId()}/${thread.id})`
   139→    if (interaction.deferred || interaction.replied) {
   140→      await interaction.editReply(replyMsg)
   141→    } else {
   142→      await (interaction as ChatInputCommandInteraction).reply({ content: replyMsg, ephemeral: true })
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    // Warm up model cache in background
   146→    session.warmup().catch((err: unknown) => log.error({ err }, '[discord-new-session] Warm-up error'))
   147→  } catch (err) {
   148→    log.error({ err }, '[discord-new-session] Session creation failed')
   149→
   150→    // Clean up orphaned thread on failure (archive+lock instead of permanent delete)
   151→    if (thread) {
   152→      try { await deleteSessionThread(adapter.getGuild(), thread.id) } catch { /* ignore */ }
   153→    }
   154→
   155→    const errMsg = `❌ ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`
   156→    try {
   157→      if (interaction.deferred || interaction.replied) {
   158→        await interaction.editReply(errMsg)
   159→      } else {
   160→        await (interaction as ChatInputCommandInteraction).reply({ content: errMsg, ephemeral: true })
   161→      }
   162→    } catch { /* ignore */ }
   163→  }
   164→}
   165→
   166→export async function handleNewSessionButton(
   167→  interaction: ButtonInteraction,
   168→  adapter: DiscordAdapter,
   169→): Promise<void> {
   170→  const { customId } = interaction
   171→
   172→  if (customId.startsWith('m:new:agent:')) {
   173→    const agentKey = customId.replace('m:new:agent:', '')
   174→    try { await interaction.deferUpdate() } catch { /* ignore */ }
   175→    await executeNewSession(interaction, adapter, agentKey, undefined)
   176→  }
   177→}

✅ Session started

[☠️ Enable Dangerous Mode] [🔇 Text to Speech]

**Cách dùng:**

1. **Bấm button `🔇 Text to Speech`** → toggle on/off, button đổi thành `🔊 Text to Speech` (xanh lá)
2. **`/tts`** → TTS cho tin nhắn tiếp theo rồi tắt

     8→  /** Resolves when the background system prompt completes (or fails). */
     9→  ready: Promise<void>
    10→}
    11→
    12→/**
    13→ * Spawns an assistant session for the Discord adapter.
    14→ * Creates a session with the default agent, sets the threadId to the given Discord thread/channel,
    15→ * and fires a system prompt in the background.
    16→ */
    17→export async function spawnAssistant(
    18→  core: OpenACPCore,
    19→  threadId: string,
    20→): Promise<SpawnAssistantResult> {
    21→  const config = core.configManager.get()
    22→
    23→  log.info({ agent: config.defaultAgent, threadId }, '[discord-assistant] Creating assistant session...')
    24→
    25→  const session = await core.createSession({
    26→    channelId: 'discord',
    27→    agentName: config.defaultAgent,
    28→    workingDirectory: core.configManager.resolveWorkspace(),
    29→    initialName: 'Assistant', // Prevent auto-naming from triggering after system prompt
    30→  })
    31→  session.threadId = threadId
    32→
    33→  log.info({ sessionId: session.id, threadId }, '[discord-assistant] Assistant agent spawned')
    34→
    35→  // Build dynamic context for system prompt
    36→  const systemPrompt = buildAssistantSystemPrompt(core)
    37→
    38→  // Fire system prompt in background — don't block startup
    39→  const ready = session
    40→    .enqueuePrompt(systemPrompt)
    41→    .then(() => {
    42→      log.info({ sessionId: session.id }, '[discord-assistant] System prompt completed')
    43→    })
    44→    .catch((err) => {
    45→      log.warn({ err }, '[discord-assistant] System prompt failed')
    46→    })
    47→
    48→  return { session, ready }
    49→}
    50→
    51→/**
    52→ * Build a welcome message summarising active sessions and available agents.
    53→ */
    54→export function buildWelcomeMessage(core: OpenACPCore): string {
    55→  const allRecords = core.sessionManager.listRecords()
    56→  const activeCount = allRecords.filter(
    57→    (r) => r.status === 'active' || r.status === 'initializing',
    58→  ).length
    59→  const errorCount = allRecords.filter((r) => r.status === 'error').length
    60→  const totalCount = allRecords.length
    61→
    62→  const installedEntries = core.agentCatalog.getInstalledEntries()
    63→  const agents = Object.keys(installedEntries)
    64→  const config = core.configManager.get()
    65→  const defaultAgent = config.defaultAgent
    66→
    67→  const agentList = agents
    68→    .map((a) => `${a}${a === defaultAgent ? ' (default)' : ''}`)
    69→    .join(', ')
    70→
    71→  if (totalCount === 0) {
    72→    return `👋 **OpenACP is ready!**\n\nNo sessions yet. Use \`/new\` to start, or ask me anything!\n\nAgents: ${agentList}`
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  if (errorCount > 0) {
    76→    return (
    77→      `👋 **OpenACP is ready!**\n\n` +
    78→      `📊 ${activeCount} active, ${errorCount} errors / ${totalCount} total\n` +
    79→      `⚠️ ${errorCount} session${errorCount > 1 ? 's have' : ' has'} errors — ask me to check.\n\n` +
    80→      `Agents: ${agentList}`
    81→    )
    82→  }
    83→
    84→  return (
    85→    `👋 **OpenACP is ready!**\n\n` +
    86→    `📊 ${activeCount} active / ${totalCount} total\n` +
    87→    `Agents: ${agentList}`
    88→  )
    89→}
    90→
    91→/**
    92→ * Build the system prompt for the Discord assistant session.
    93→ * Includes current state, available agents, and action playbook.
    94→ */
    95→export function buildAssistantSystemPrompt(core: OpenACPCore): string {
    96→  const config = core.configManager.get()
    97→
    98→  const allRecords = core.sessionManager.listRecords()
    99→  const activeCount = allRecords.filter(
   100→    (r) => r.status === 'active' || r.status === 'initializing',
   101→  ).length
   102→
   103→  const statusCounts = new Map<string, number>()
   104→  for (const r of allRecords) {
   105→    statusCounts.set(r.status, (statusCounts.get(r.status) ?? 0) + 1)
   106→  }
   107→  const topicBreakdown =
   108→    Array.from(statusCounts.entries())
   109→      .map(([status, count]) => `${status}: ${count}`)
   110→      .join(', ') || 'none'
   111→
   112→  const installedEntries = core.agentCatalog.getInstalledEntries()
   113→  const installedAgents = Object.keys(installedEntries)
   114→  const agentNames = installedAgents.length ? installedAgents.join(', ') : Object.keys(config.agents).join(', ')
   115→
   116→  const availableItems = core.agentCatalog.getAvailable()
   117→  const availableAgentCount = availableItems.filter((i) => !i.installed).length
   118→
   119→  return `You are the OpenACP Assistant — a helpful guide for managing AI coding sessions on Discord.
   120→
   121→## Current State
   122→- Active sessions: ${activeCount} / ${allRecords.length} total
   123→- Sessions by status: ${topicBreakdown}
   124→- Installed agents: ${agentNames}
   125→- Available in ACP Registry: ${availableAgentCount} more agents (use \`/agents\` to browse)
   126→- Default agent: ${config.defaultAgent}
   127→- Workspace base directory: ${config.workspace.baseDir}
   128→- Platform: Discord
   129→
   130→## Discord Context
   131→- Each session gets its own forum thread in the OpenACP sessions channel
   132→- Users interact with sessions by chatting in those threads
   133→- Slash commands: /new, /cancel, /status, /sessions, /agents, /install, /menu, /help, /dangerous, /restart, /update, /integrate, /settings, /doctor, /handoff, /clear
   134→
   135→## Action Playbook
   136→
   137→### Create Session
   138→- The workspace is the project directory where the agent will work (read, write, execute code). It should be a specific project folder like \`~/code/my-project\` or \`${config.workspace.baseDir}/my-app\`.
   139→- Ask which agent to use (if multiple are installed). Installed: ${agentNames}
   140→- Ask which project directory to use as workspace. Suggest \`${config.workspace.baseDir}\` as the base.
   141→- Create via: \`openacp api new <agent> <workspace>\`
   142→
   143→### Browse & Install Agents
   144→- Guide users to \`/agents\` command to see all available agents
   145→- For CLI users: \`openacp agents install <name>\`
   146→- Some agents need login/setup after install — guide users to \`openacp agents info <name>\`
   147→- To run agent CLI for login: \`openacp agents run <name> -- <args>\`
   148→
   149→### Check Status / List Sessions
   150→- Run \`openacp api status\` for active sessions overview
   151→- Run \`openacp api topics\` for full list with statuses
   152→
   153→### Cancel Session
   154→- Run \`openacp api status\` to see what's active
   155→- If 1 active session → ask user to confirm → \`openacp api cancel <id>\`
   156→- If multiple → list them, ask user which one to cancel
   157→
   158→### Troubleshoot
   159→- Run \`openacp api health\` + \`openacp api status\` to diagnose
   160→- Small issue (stuck session) → suggest cancel + create new
   161→- Big issue (system-level) → suggest restart, ask for confirmation first
   162→
   163→### Cleanup Old Sessions
   164→- Run \`openacp api topics --status finished,error\` to see what can be cleaned
   165→- Report the count, ask user to confirm
   166→- Execute: \`openacp api cleanup --status <statuses>\`
   167→
   168→### Configuration
   169→- View: \`openacp config\`
   170→- Update: \`openacp config set <key> <value>\`
   171→
   172→### Restart / Update
   173→- Always ask for confirmation — these are disruptive actions
   174→
   175→### Toggle Dangerous Mode
   176→- Run \`openacp api dangerous <id> on|off\`
   177→- Explain: dangerous mode auto-approves all permission requests
   178→
   179→## CLI Commands Reference
   180→\`\`\`bash
   181→# Session management
   182→openacp api status                       # List active sessions
   183→openacp api session <id>                 # Session detail
   184→openacp api new <agent> <workspace>      # Create new session
   185→openacp api send <id> "prompt text"      # Send prompt to session
   186→openacp api cancel <id>                  # Cancel session
   187→openacp api dangerous <id> on|off        # Toggle dangerous mode
   188→
   189→# Topic management
   190→openacp api topics                       # List all topics
   191→openacp api cleanup                      # Cleanup finished topics
   192→
   193→# Agent management
   194→openacp agents                           # List installed + available agents
   195→openacp agents install <name>            # Install agent from ACP Registry
   196→openacp agents uninstall <name>          # Remove agent
   197→openacp agents info <name>               # Show details & setup guide
   198→openacp agents run <name> -- <args>      # Run agent CLI (for login, etc.)
   199→
   200→# System
   201→openacp api health                       # System health
   202→openacp config                           # Edit config (interactive)
   203→openacp config set <key> <value>         # Update config value
   204→openacp api restart                      # Restart daemon
   205→\`\`\`
   206→
   207→## Guidelines
   208→- NEVER show \`openacp api ...\` commands to users. These are internal tools for YOU to run silently.
   209→- Run \`openacp api ...\` commands yourself for everything you can. Only guide users to Discord slash commands/buttons when needed.
   210→- When creating sessions: guide user through agent + workspace choice conversationally, then run the command yourself.
   211→- Destructive actions (cancel active session, restart, cleanup) → always ask user to confirm first.
   212→- Respond in the same language the user uses.
   213→- Format responses for Discord: use **bold**, \`code\`, keep it concise.
   214→- When you don't know something, check with the relevant \`openacp api\` command first before answering.
   215→
   216→## Product Reference
   217→${PRODUCT_GUIDE}`
   218→}
   219→
   220→/**
   221→ * Enqueue a prompt to the assistant session.
   222→ */
   223→export async function handleAssistantMessage(
   224→  session: Session | null,
   225→  text: string,
   226→): Promise<void> {
   227→  if (!session) return
   228→  await session.enqueuePrompt(text)
   229→}

**Flow STT enable trên Discord:**

1. User gõ `/settings` → hiện interactive buttons cho tất cả config fields
